tha-ap356:1.1: samattaṃ. [351. Sakoṭakakoraṇḍadāyaka.] Akkantañ ca padaṃ disvā Sikhino lokabandhuno / ekaṃsam ajinaṃ katvā padaseyyam avandi 'haṃ. // //
tha-ap356:2.1: Koraṇḍaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā pādapaṃ dharaṇīruhaṃ / sakoṭakaṃ gahetvāna pade cakkam apūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap356:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi padapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap356:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sakoṭakakoraṇḍadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
